partC_theAnswer.recommendation: Run free tier by default for every verified buyer, zero marginal provider cost, already inside verify(). Call BrightData only for the ~56% left with role_statement/generic/none, and expect it to convert about 1 in 5 of those into a usable on-topic hook at $0.0025-plus-cents each; the other 4 in 5 either have no LinkedIn activity or post off-topic content, so BrightData is a targeted top-up, not a default second pass.
